authorization: User requested GPT-6 Astra Ultra to complete the outstanding book questions and finish the paper.

bookReferenceConstruction.review: Author semantic self-check plus deterministic integrity checks; not independent human validation.
bookReferenceConstruction.sourceAccess: Selected canonical sections and neighboring context; no retrieval outputs accessed by authoring agents.
bookReferenceConstruction.paraphrases: Natural semantic paraphrases; technical terms retained. Paraphrases are not proof of uncontaminated evaluation.

operationalEvaluation.timingSampling: Existing seeded schedule: 50 per corpus; per-book counts reported, not asserted equal.

secondaryEvaluation.referencePolicy: Unchanged frozen QASPER first-human answer or unchanged book answer, with provenance declared for every record.
secondaryEvaluation.faithfulnessApplicability: Nonempty nonabstaining answers with supplied evidence only; other cases are NA.
secondaryEvaluation.answerAccuracyApplicability: Positive-reference nonempty answers, including abstentions; negatives excluded and abstention reported separately.
secondaryEvaluation.factualCorrectness: Development diagnostic only; excluded from main test before inspecting outputs.

optionalAblations.reason: Complete the seven-method main comparison with explicit model-authored references and calibrated automatic answer evaluation. Optional structure/window/order sweeps remain future work, not missing main-study results.

budget.fullStudyForecast: Required after a fresh combined QASPER/book development pilot with the final implementation.
budget.authoringCodexCost: Not available as metered API usage; reported separately as unpriced authoring resource, not zero-dollar retrieval.

limitations: Mostly model-authored book references and no independent human validation of them.
Author, generator, and judge share a provider family; different models do not guarantee independent errors.
Public sources may occur in undisclosed training data.
Only eight test books; book questions are not independent document units.
Automatic answer metrics do not establish citation correctness or replace human review.
